stories.title: Stanlow refinery broke permit conditions 58 times in two years, Environment Agency finds
stories.summary: Natural England dropped an investigation into an oil spill from Stanlow refinery after deciding the site’s permit set no limit on oil released, the BBC said, citing internal emails. stories.title: Mynydd Isa Scout leader to lead school repair team in Malawi over Christmas
stories.summary: A Scout leader from Mynydd Isa will spend Christmas and New Year in Malawi leading a team repairing a primary school damaged by a tropical cyclone. Lily, a leader with Mynydd Isa Scouts, has been selected to join a group of 10 Scouts from across the UK and is the only one travelling from Wales.

stories.title: Former Deeside College trainee completes degree while managing 300 staff at Kingspan

stories.title: Parents must be treated as “vital to the care team” in Welsh neonatal units, minister tells Senedd
stories.summary: Parents must be treated as “vital to the care team” and not as visitors when their child receives neonatal care, Wales’ Women’s Minister has said. stories.title: Ken Skates praises ‘resilience’ of Connah’s Quay veterans’ hub
stories.summary: A Connah’s Quay veterans’ project that was told in 2022 it would end is still running, with its own café and veteran-led cleaning and gardening services.
